atomvm-can-coordinate-a-native-radio-wor.next: Deferred by user; excluded from the active evaluation goal.
atomvm-can-coordinate-a-native-radio-wor.rationale: The user clarified AtomVM need not be integrated. Preserve the proposal with unchecked tasks for possible future work.

the-board-can-be-restored-after-an-sdr-t.next: Record an actual power-removal/reapplication boot and finish recovery acceptance.
the-board-can-be-restored-after-an-sdr-t.rationale: Two matching complete flash reads are proven; first post-trial restore/readback matches and resets. Cold power-cycle proof remains open.

the-board-captures-repeatable-radio-snap.next: Accepted capture-transport record; controlled RF evaluation continues in separate proposals.
the-board-captures-repeatable-radio-snap.rationale: Independent review accepted all five capture tasks and synced two grounded requirements. Scope is CRC/count integrity, measured delivery timing and display provenance, not calibrated or known-signal RF reception.

the-spectrum-reveals-controlled-24ghz-si.next: Measure controlled source-on/source-off responses with verified settings and uncertainties.
the-spectrum-reveals-controlled-24ghz-si.rationale: Integrity-checked spectrum tooling and an owned BLE source exist; source registration alone does not establish receiver response.

the-receiver-can-observe-and-decode-shor.next: Capture counted repeat events and verify payloads before claiming detection or decoding reliability.
the-receiver-can-observe-and-decode-shor.rationale: Bounded BLE source/decoder tools are tested; commanded advertising intervals do not supply exact over-the-air emission counts.

the-fpga-route-has-a-measured-feasibilit.next: Identify the actual Forgix revision and electrical interface before a bounded synthetic transport trial.
the-fpga-route-has-a-measured-feasibilit.rationale: Source review and reproducible budgets select a bounded route. No FPGA programming, transport/DMA or RF benchmark has run.

the-two-receivers-have-a-measured-divisi.next: Verify the RTL antenna/source application and physically inventory the common-signal conversion path.
the-two-receivers-have-a-measured-divisi.rationale: RTL delivery/FM artifacts and ESP snapshot timing support published practical recommendations. Known-source application and shared-signal conversion gates remain open.
